summary:
Tested FINANCE_004, VENDORS_001, FIELDOPS_001, PROJECT_002 across backend (pytest 9/9 passed) and frontend UI. Backend contract fully complete: profit_last_year field present with correct math, /projects/{1,2,3}/ledger returns credits+debits with net verification, org-wide employee creation (project_id=null), phase assignment (201) + duplicate 409 + unassign 204, project employees union includes phase-assigned emp, attendance for phase-member 201, attendance for non-member 422, vendor POST works, SE 403 regressions intact. Frontend UI: vendor Add + modal + create works and appears in table; PhaseCrew section renders on all 3 phases of project 1 with crew-add/chip/remove; SE portal shows org-employee-register + se-add-employee-button + 10 rows; Ledger section renders on project 1/2/3 finance pages with correct credit/debit/net figures.

ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND (FINANCE_004): The Profit card on /admin/projects/{id}/finance is bound to s.profit (all-time) instead of s.profit_last_year, AND is missing the `sub` prop entirely, so the required `data-testid="pf-profit-period"` element is NOT rendered. Currently displays 'Profit −₹5.03 Cr' with no date range. Expected: a positive/negative figure equal to revenue_last_year - cost_last_year plus a '1 year · YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD' subline.

ui_bugs.issue: Profit summary card uses value={fmtCr(s.profit)} instead of s.profit_last_year and does NOT pass a `sub` prop, so the required data-testid="pf-profit-period" 1-year date range is never rendered. FINANCE_004 spec not satisfied on the frontend.

action_items: Fix ProjectFinancePage.jsx Profit card (line 95): change value to fmtCr(s.profit_last_year) and add sub={`1 year · ${s.period_from} → ${s.period_to}`} so data-testid pf-profit-period is rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend contract for FINANCE_004 (profit_last_year, revenue_last_year, cost_last_year, period_from, period_to) is correct and consistent — the field is returned by /api/projects/{id}/finance/summary. Only the frontend consumer of that field is wrong.

PhaseCrew works well; API returns items with `employee_id` key (not `id`) — main agent may want to standardize this shape across employee-listing endpoints (project employees returns `id`, phase employees returns `employee_id`).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_V_UI_* vendor, TEST_EMP_* org-wide employee (assigned then unassigned from phase), TEST_LEG_* project-scoped employee. All prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus retest on FINANCE_004 pf-profit-period rendering after main agent fixes ProjectFinancePage line 95. Everything else — vendors add, PhaseCrew assign/remove, org-wide employee, attendance union, ledger section on p1/p2/p3, SE 403 regressions — verified passing.
rca of the issue: FINANCE_004 partial regression: backend correctly returns profit_last_year but ProjectFinancePage.jsx binds the Profit card to the older s.profit field and omits the sub prop. Since ProjectFinanceSummaryCard only emits data-testid=`${testId}-period` when `sub` is truthy (line 23), pf-profit-period never renders. Two-line fix in ProjectFinancePage.jsx line 95.
